constraints.description: EQUIPMENT cannot be deleted if CARDS reference it (eqpt_id FK in t_cards)
constraints.rule: DELETE t_equipments WHERE eqpt_id IS REFERENCED BY t_cards.eqpt_id → BLOCKED

constraints.description: CARD cannot be deleted if PORTS reference it (card_id FK in t_ports)
constraints.rule: DELETE t_cards WHERE card_id IS REFERENCED BY t_ports.card_id → BLOCKED

constraints.description: NODE cannot be deleted if EQUIPMENTS or DISTRIBUTORS reference it
constraints.rule: DELETE t_nodes WHERE node_id IS REFERENCED BY t_equipments.node_id OR t_distributors.node_id → BLOCKED

constraints.description: MAKING_FILE cannot be processed if status is blocking (mkfl_status)
constraints.rule: PROCESS t_making_files WHERE mkfl_status IN (BLOCKED, CANCELLED) → REJECTED

constraints.description: PORT cannot be assigned if port_attribuable = 0
constraints.rule: ASSIGN t_ports WHERE port_attribuable = 0 → BLOCKED

constraints.description: CCL cannot accept new VCs if rpct_allocated_vc_count >= rpct_vc_max
constraints.rule: ASSIGN VC ON t_res_prod_controlables WHERE allocated_vc_count >= vc_max → REJECTED

constraints.description: EPC cannot have duplicate epc_epc_id
constraints.rule: INSERT t_epcs WHERE epc_epc_id ALREADY EXISTS → UNIQUE VIOLATION

constraints.description: FTTH ONT lock requires unique (ont_num, port_id) pair
constraints.rule: INSERT t_ftth_lock_onts WHERE (flko_ont_num, port_id) ALREADY EXISTS → UNIQUE CONSTRAINT

constraints.description: DSLAM closed for production blocks all port assignment (recherche broche)
constraints.rule: IF dslam_prod_status = CLOSED THEN AffecterRessourcesXdslService → FAIL with 'fermé à la production'

constraints.description: CARD closed for production blocks port assignment on that card
constraints.rule: IF card_prod_status = CLOSED THEN AffecterRessourcesXdslService → FAIL with 'carte fermée à la production'

constraints.description: CCL (VC) NumeroCCL is mandatory for CEV offers
constraints.rule: IF offer_type = CEV AND rpct_ccl_name IS NULL THEN AffecterRessourcesXdslService → ERROR 'Le NumeroCCL est obligatoire dans le cas d\'une offre CEV'

constraints.description: EPC identifier already used by another EPC (duplicate detection)
constraints.rule: IF epc_epc_id ALREADY IN USE → AffecterRessourcesXdslService → ERROR 'L\'identifiant d\'EPC est déjà utilisé'

constraints.description: MRT Access DSLAM identifier unknown blocks liberation (LibérerRessources)
constraints.rule: IF mrtd_id NOT FOUND → LibererRessourcesXdslService → ERROR 'Identifiant de Macro Ressource Technique inconnu'

constraints.description: EPC dossier de réalisation ID unknown blocks modification
constraints.rule: IF mkfl_id NOT FOUND → ModifierDonneesCommerciales → ERROR 'Identifiant de dossier de réalisation inconnu'

constraints.description: Port counter (TOC) at 100% prevents new port assignment on DSLAM
constraints.rule: IF DSLAM_TOC = 100% THEN RechercherBrochesService → FAIL 'No port found with such constraints'

constraints.description: Access already being modified (dossier en cours) blocks concurrent modification
constraints.rule: IF mkfl_status = IN_PROGRESS → AffecterRessourcesXdslService → ERROR 'L\'accès est déjà en cours de modification'

constraints.description: MRTChemin already carried by another MRTAccesDslam blocks new assignment
constraints.rule: IF mrtd_crc_mrt_id ALREADY ASSIGNED TO ANOTHER MRTD → ERROR 'Un accès client existe déjà avec le même identifiant'

constraints.description: Deadlock in PostgreSQL causes provisioning rollback and retry with 55s delay
constraints.rule: IF PSQLException deadlock_detected → ROLLBACK → RETRY after 55000ms (max 3 attempts)

constraints.description: SCA blocking caused by missing FARID or RemoteID
constraints.rule: IF farid IS NULL OR remote_id IS NULL → SCA_BLOCKED

constraints.description: DSLAM constraint on repartiteur must exist before DSLAM assignment
constraints.rule: IF t_dslam_access_constraints FOR node DOES NOT EXIST → assignment blocked

constraints.description: VP/VLAN/VC counter incorrect (occupied wrongly) blocks new resource assignment
constraints.rule: IF ctrs_occupied_count MISMATCH ACTUAL USAGE → new VC assignment may fail

constraints.description: NIFolderID field missing (Error 1002) - mandatory field validation
constraints.rule: IF nifolderid IS NULL IN INCOMING MESSAGE → BRASIL ERROR 1002 'Champ obligatoire NIFolderID non présent'

constraints.description: UPDATEDMRTLIST field absent or format error (Error 1002)
constraints.rule: IF updatedmrtlist IS NULL OR FORMAT_INVALID → BRASIL ERROR 1002

constraints.description: DLM blocked orders require manual reprocessing via Brasil N3 procedure
constraints.rule: IF mkfl_business_process = DLM AND mkfl_status = BLOCKED → manual intervention required

constraints.description: Port réseau without service or endpoint is invalid resource
constraints.rule: IF port_occup_status = OCCUPIED AND NO_SERVICE AND NO_ENDPOINT → data inconsistency requires correction

constraints.description: BBC movement without Brasil action requires investigation
constraints.rule: IF bbc_movement_received AND NO_BRASIL_ACTION → data_sync_failure

constraints.description: TSF resources not found for DSLAM causes internal error on service assignment
constraints.rule: IF TSF resources not available ON DSLAM → BrasilInternalErrorException on resource reservation
